clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move across the country to buy an apple orchard in March 1952, within months: June's homesickness and daily writing to her sister, distance between June and Walter as he worked long hours, Glen's fights at school, Walter's cutoff from his brother Harlan over their father's land money, June kept to her bed for weeks that first winter, rows between Walter and June over money for trees, and June joining the church choir by September 1953 as her anxiety eased and she began to function better. The shifts pile up from May 1952 through September 1953 as the family settled into the valley.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failure, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when the late frost took the whole crop and the bank called in the loan: Walter drank heavily most nights by June, he and Glen blamed each other for the loan by July, Glen overfunctioned by taking over the family's money and talks with the bank by November, Carl's asthma attacks worsened that winter, Nora began wetting the bed in April 1969, and Walter's mother Ida's heart trouble was found in May 1969. Walter stopped drinking and took pruning work by October 1969. The shifts span from June 1968 to October 1969, tightening around the sale in October 1968.

clusters.name: Glen's job loss at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975: Glen sat out of work in the truck in the yard for hours by May, loud fights broke out between Glen and Marian at night over money, Marian took a second job cleaning offices at night, Nora stopped eating properly and lost weight by August, Nora kept to her room and distanced from Marian by October, and Walter drank again after six years off it by December 1975. Nora's functioning came back by June 1976 when she began eating again and made the track team. Glen started driving a delivery truck for the feed store in March 1976. The shifts span May 1975 to June 1976.

clusters.name: Wilma's move into Nora and Hollis's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Hollis's mother Wilma moving into Nora and Hollis's house in January 1990: Nora clashed with Wilma over the children's bedtimes and meals by April, Hollis worked late and kept out of the kitchen rows by May, Hollis took his mother's side, Owen had tantrums at preschool by June, Wilma took over Lily's care by August, Nora's eczema flared on both hands by September, and Nora and Hollis had rows most nights by November. Nora's mother Marian drove over twice a week to take her side by January 1991. Wilma took a flat in town by June 1991, and Nora's eczema cleared over the summer. The shifts run from April 1990 through August 1991.

declined.reason: An acute episode around a real threat: the wildfire of August 1994 lasted four days from the evacuation order to the family's return home, with all shifts within those days and everyone calm again within a week once home.

Tess's drinking began in October 1996, but no change in the family on a known date sits among these events to open a period. Nora's worry and overfunctioning are her reactions to Tess's trouble, not a shift in the family itself around a structural change.
